meta.wedge: Detect WhatsApp leads who go silent after a price quote, diagnose WHY they ghosted, prescribe an owner-approved recovery message, and log recovered revenue.
meta.vault: /Users/srila/AI-Growth-Operator/Growth-Operator-Vault (code repo docs/ is a symlink to this)
meta.grounding_note: Statuses are evidenced against the actual code tree; depth (tables, events, tickets, spec refs) is sourced from the Obsidian vault. PROGRESS since 2026-07-21 (branch feature/mvp-011-otp-auth, uncommitted): migration 001 (users, sessions, otp_challenges) now exists; two auth routes are live (POST /v1/auth/otp and /v1/auth/otp/verify); argon2 hashing + JWT issue; the OTP channel is an INTERIM email path (phone kept behind a flag) while Meta WhatsApp API access is pending; a gated EmailOtpDelivery (SMTP) adapter is written but OFF by default; a preview email-OTP login page exists in web/. Verified via 48 backend tests (45 unit + 3 live-DB integration) + frontend build; the live-DB path is now VERIFIED against Postgres 16 (OrbStack): migration 001 up+down+re-up round-trip and the full request->verify->token flow both pass. Still true: no LLM SDK is a dependency; the core wedge mechanic (ghost detection -> diagnosis -> recovery -> attribution) is entirely unbuilt and the diagnosis differentiator is absent from code AND vault design; the jewellery pack is still only declarative YAML/markdown that no loader reads.
meta.diagnosis_gap_note: The wedge's differentiator — diagnosing WHY a lead ghosted — is absent from code AND from the vault design. The vault's own recovery spec (32-jewelry-mvp-playbooks/missed-follow-up-recovery-playbook.md) and workflow (silent_lead_reactivation.yaml) go straight from a 72h-silence trigger to 'compose ONE nudge or SKIP' with NO reason inference. So diagnosis must be designed first, then built.
meta.scoring: Rollup % is computed in status.html from leaf statuses: DONE=1, PARTIAL=0.5, NOT_STARTED/BLOCKED/UNCERTAIN=0. DEFERRED leaves are excluded from numerator and denominator so future scope never dilutes the wedge %.

tracks.name: Access & Identity (auth) — MVP-011
tracks.notes: Foundational owner sign-in. Not part of the wedge mechanic but gates every authenticated flow. Built 2026-07-22 on branch feature/mvp-011-otp-auth (uncommitted); interim email-OTP channel while Meta WhatsApp API access is pending.

children.name: OTP auth logic (validation, argon2 hashing, challenge state machine, JWT)
children.what_exists: E.164 + email validation, channel dispatch, 6-digit code gen, argon2 hashing, Challenge state machine (5m expiry / <=5 attempts / 60s resend), JWT mint+decode (15m access / 30d refresh). 37 unit assertions pass.
children.what_is_missing: Nothing for the pure logic.
children.next_action: None — stable; consumed by the routes.
children.notes: OTP failures use plain HTTP (401/422/429), not the closed canonical error taxonomy (CLAUDE.md §13).

children.name: Migration 001 — users, sessions, otp_challenges (global, no RLS)
children.what_exists: Global identity tables; users.phone nullable + CHECK(phone OR email); otp_challenges generalized to (channel, identifier). Offline SQL generation verified. Live: upgrade + downgrade base + re-upgrade verified against Postgres 16 (OrbStack); columns/indexes/CHECKs inspected.
children.what_is_missing: Nothing outstanding — up/down round-trip verified live.
children.next_action: None — verified.
children.notes: Membership deferred to user_orgs (migration 002, MVP-014).

children.name: Auth API — POST /v1/auth/otp, /v1/auth/otp/verify

Live end-to-end verified: request->verify->token writes real users/sessions rows; wrong-code 401 and lockout 429 covered (3 integration tests).
